text: Program Description UIBE is one of China’s most international schools and a highly regarded university of "Project 211". Due to a unique academic structure, students take classes taught in English with other international students from over 100 countries in the most international area of Beijing. You will join a first-class and most advanced program, study with the experienced and high-quality faculty, improve your mandarin skills by practicing with local people. Business Administration program of UIBE is strongly favored by more and more top talent students home and abroad. Main Courses and Credits Each student must complete 54 credits of courses including 36 compulsory, 18 elective and 8 for a practicum requirement. Degree Awarded Bachelor of Economics
